title: SCP-1025, Encyclopedia of Common Diseases
description: An ordinary looking book that infects its reader with the very diseases it describes.
body:
Encyclopedia of Common Diseases adds a new item. Its history comes from the SCP universe, where it is referred to as SCP-1025, also known as the Encyclopedia of Common Diseases.


SCP-1025 is an anomalous book that can be found laying on the ground. Each page describes a different effect like Weakness, Slowness, Poison and other effects from other SCP Mods like Amnesia, Infection or Insomnia. Upon opening those pages, the player immediately suffers from its effects. The book can be placed down again, but beware, reading its pages comes at a price.

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>



► [OLD] What is my console spaming?

Most mobs use special spawning conditions, which means that these mobs can only appear under certain conditions. If the spawning conditions work, this spam is created in the console.

► [OLD] Why can't I summon a mob?

Spawning Conditions determine which conditions must be met in order to spawn certain mobs. Some mobs only spawn above Y level 60. Some below. Most mobs can only spawn in the overworld than in other dimensions.

► Why are features missing in different versions?

It is recommended to play the newest versions of higher minecraft versions.

Not all features of MCreator available or the same in different versions.
For example: Version 1.19.2 doesn't have the feature of shield, better structure generation or custom villagers, but Version 1.20.1 does have them.

► Is this mod compatible with Infectious, SCP-015-IT and SCP-500?

Yes! SCP-1025 is compatible with Infectious, SCP-500 and SCP-015-IT. 

The Antibiotics from Infectious and the Antidepressive from SCP-015-IT will clear the Infection and Fear Effect. A pill from SCP-500 will also clear every effect.

► Where does SCP-1025 spawn?

SCP-1025 can spawn anywhere in the overworld like a normal monster. However, there can only be one instance of SCP-1025.

</details>



![SCP-1025](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/277427854d982d219f19e9c23d830ef53cb9e083.png)

SCP-1025 appears as a thin, petrol colored book with the titel "The Encyclopedia of Common Diseases - Coltan Press". When right-clicked, it opens to reveal various entries on effects. Every page you open gives you the exact effect that is descripted on that page. The Book Pages include Weakness, Slowness, Mining Fatique, Nausea, Hunger, Amnesia, Infection, Insomnia, Fear, Blindness, Poison, Corrision and Wither. SCP-1025 can also be placed down again to contain it by right clicking a block with SCP-1025 in the main hand.
